def factor_range_pressure_downvol_cubic(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # Primary: cycle range pressure over 60 days (from market_cycle_0002)
    buy_pressure = (close - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - close).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    range_pressure = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # Lightweight modifier: downside volume participation, cubic attenuation to reduce over-dampening during moderate regimes
    ret = close.pct_change()
    down_vol = volume.where(ret < 0, 0.0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    total_vol = volume.rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_ratio = down_vol / total_vol
    attenuation = 1.0 - down_ratio ** 3
    factor = range_pressure * attenuation
    df_copy["factor_range_pressure_downvol_cubic"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_pressure_downvol_cubic"]
description: Preserves the parent's primary cycle range-pressure mechanism from market_cycle_0002, which identifies accumulation/distribution phase by the position of closes within the trailing 60-day high-low range. The parent's squared downside-volume attenuation may still over-dampen the signal during moderate downside-volume regimes, weakening raw IC/ICIR without improving rank stability. This mutation changes the attenuation power from 2 to 3, making the dampening more gentle across typical values of down_ratio while retaining strong dampening when downside volume becomes dominant. This preserves the raw range-pressure strength most of the time, targeting improved IC and ICIR while retaining the stable RankIC/RankICIR and MI profile of the qualified parent. Cross-sectional transform remains none to preserve raw payoff structure.
